## Pull request overview

This pull request resolves protocol naming conflicts by renaming two sets of protocol files that shared identical names despite serving distinct purposes. The changes improve code clarity and reduce developer confusion when choosing between similar protocols.

**Changes:**
- Renamed `automation/connector.zod.ts` to `automation/trigger-registry.zod.ts` to clearly differentiate lightweight automation triggers from enterprise integration connectors
- Renamed `api/cache.zod.ts` to `api/http-cache.zod.ts` to distinguish HTTP-level caching from application-level caching
- Added comprehensive inline documentation to both protocol pairs explaining architectural boundaries and decision criteria
- Updated all import/export statements across 7 files to reflect the new naming
